title: Red Flag-Rescue 19-1
description: U.S. Army Special Forces soldiers partnering with U.S. Air Force aircrew members, assigned to Alaskan Air National Guard unit 211th Rescue Squadron, perform a RAPID vehicle extrication method utilizing an HC-130J Hercules during exercise Red Flag-Rescue 19-1 at Davis-Monthan Air Force Base, Arizona, May 4, 2019. Red Flag-Rescue allows joint service members the opportunity to prepare for the high-end fight in contested, degraded and operationally limited environments. (U.S. Air Force video by Staff Sergeant Taylor Harrison)
